column1: # Desktop artifacts, pinned by SHA-256. Columns (tab separated): name, file, URL, SHA-256, architecture (x86_64 or arm64).
# The NVIDIA installer is not here: fetch-artifacts.sh downloads the host's own driver version and checks NVIDIA's published SHA-256.
# A name ending -ubuntu26.04 is for the Wayland desktop on Ubuntu 26.04; the same name without it, for 24.04.

# tigervnc: SHA-256 of the file whose MD5 SourceForge lists for the release. chrome: from Google's stable Packages index, InRelease signed by EB4C1BFD4F042F6DDDCCEC917721F63BD38B4796. virtualgl and selkies: GitHub release asset digest.
